answer: The copper counter is kept in dawn and echo reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 14 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An adversary therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 14 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 943 identities would post 1858 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
